events.content:
Updated [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) to show a welcome message and schedule each page view with Next.js `after()`. The page renders dynamically so the event is logged per request.

Added [lib/analytics.ts](/workspace/lib/analytics.ts), which posts a page-view event to `ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT`. If that variable is unset, it logs the event to the server console. Analytics errors are caught after the response is sent.

I didn’t run tests. The existing `package.json` change and untracked `package-lock.json` were left untouched.

item.text:
Updated [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) to show a welcome message and schedule each page view with Next.js `after()`. The page renders dynamically so the event is logged per request.

Added [lib/analytics.ts](/workspace/lib/analytics.ts), which posts a page-view event to `ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT`. If that variable is unset, it logs the event to the server console. Analytics errors are caught after the response is sent.

I didn’t run tests. The existing `package.json` change and untracked `package-lock.json` were left untouched.
